_comment: projects: every repo supergit stewards (`supergit init <path> --register` adds one); add "dev_port": <number> to an entry once you know the project's local dev port, so two rooms never guess the same one. guarded_libraries: main checkouts the Claude Code PreToolUse hook refuses to edit outside a room; SUPERGIT_GUARD_ALL=1 guards every listed project. SUPERGIT_PROJECTS=/a:/b adds projects without editing this file.
